parsed.production_notes: The main visual is a static, AI-generated image of a giant robot and a man, with minimal animation for lip-sync and gestures. This is combined with standard screen recordings of a mobile app and human voiceover.
parsed.interaction_pattern: AI tutor SAYS a phrase in Hindi, learner TRANSLATES it to English (translation drill), followed by a testimonial where the learner explains how the app helped him.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue between two characters (a female AI tutor and a male learner) and a voiceover from the male learner explaining the app's features. There is no background music.

characters.appearance: A giant, female-presenting android with a humanoid face, glowing blue eyes, and no hair. Her body is constructed from sleek white and silver metallic plates with visible joints and mechanical details, particularly around the neck and shoulders. She has a slender, athletic build.

characters.demeanor: Authoritative, encouraging, and knowledgeable, like a teacher.

characters.demeanor: Respectful, eager to learn, and grateful towards his teacher.

scenes.setting: A vast, futuristic, industrial hall at night, illuminated by purple and blue neon lights. The atmosphere is hazy, with complex machinery and pipes in the background.

panels.panel_visual_description: A giant, white and silver female-presenting android, Character A, stands in a vast, futuristic industrial hall bathed in purple and blue light. She looks down and gestures towards a much smaller man, Character B, who stands on a metal catwalk before her. The man, an Indian male in his late 20s, looks up at her with his hands clasped, appearing earnest and attentive. The background is filled with complex machinery, pipes, and glowing screens, creating a high-tech, slightly hazy atmosphere.
